.]] Sun rocs are large Kalimdorian birds of prey that feature prominently in tauren mythology as heralds and messengers of the sun god An'she. They were believed to carry with them the first flame before dawn and the final light of evenfall. The birds inspired many legends and were commonly believed to be descendants of phoenixes. The ancient tauren saw them as living manifestations of An'she's fire. The sun rocs disappeared from Kalimdor at some point. The Explorers' League believed them to be mythical until they discovered a large, petrified talon from one off of the southern coast of Stranglethorn Vale; the talon is on display in the Ironforge museum.
